about_the_game:
Danger Lurking in the Dark: Escape Challenge

In this tense first-person horror game set in the dark corridors of an abandoned hospital, you must use your courage and intelligence to survive. The threat in the silence follows you as a frightening silhouette emerging from the darkness. In this frightening world where light means safety and darkness means death, will you be able to find your escape?

Gameplay Mechanics:

Movement and Exploration:

Walk through the dark corridors of the hospital with the W, A, S, D keys.

Flashlight Usage:

Turn your flashlight on or off with the F key. Light is the only thing that protects you from the dark threat!

Silhouette Appearing in the Dark:

The silhouette of the creature always appears in the dark and follows you.

The silhouette stops when the player enters the light.

Be careful when passing through dark corridors, it is always there!

Key Features:

Realistic AI: Light-sensitive creatures follow you step by step. However, it remains motionless when you enter the light!

Cinematic Experience: Experience the height of fear with special capture animations and video sequences.

Atmospheric Gameplay: Experience tension-filled moments with dynamic lighting, eerie dark silhouettes and impressive sound effects.

Puzzle and Strategy: Discover the secrets of the abandoned hospital, solve locks and find an escape route to survive.

Escape or Get Caught!

Keep your eyes open if you want to survive in this dark hospital! The silhouette follows you from the darkness... It stops when you enter the light, but does that make you safe?

  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • DirectX: Version 11
